$comment: Single source of truth for the harness model catalog. Consumed by both TS (harness-models.ts) and deploy scripts (harness-models.mjs). Each entry pins a model to a known-good (provider, apiFormat) pair so the AgentCore harness loop produces a request shape valid for THAT model's endpoint. See harness-models.ts for the full rationale.

models.label: Claude Fable 5 (Recommended)
models.description: Most capable general model. Native Converse; handles tool loops + prefill.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.description: Fast, strong default for most tasks. Native Converse.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.8 (via Mantle)
models.description: Opus 4.8 through the Bedrock Mantle Responses endpoint. Required — this model rejects the harness loop's prefill turn on native Converse.

models.label: OpenAI GPT-5.4 (via Mantle)
models.description: GPT-5.4 via Bedrock Mantle — uses execution-role creds, no API key.
